name: assayer
description: Evidence-backed frontend audits from a URL in Codex

interface.shortDescription: Audit a web URL with bounded, evidence-backed checks.
interface.longDescription: Assayer guides Codex through a safe frontend audit: it observes a real page, checks enabled rules, records evidence, and explains completed, partial, or failed results. The user only needs to provide a URL.
defaultPrompt: Audit this web URL for frontend issues: <URL>
Continue the Assayer audit and explain the current progress.
Explain the Assayer result and what I should do next.
